notes: Append-only audit logging stories defined with no duplication.

change_log.value: Added 5 stories covering schema, core logic, API, integration, and tests

stories.title: Audit Log Schema and Contract Definition
stories.description: Define immutable audit log schema including event_type, actor, timestamp, payload, hash, and previous_hash fields. Ensure compatibility with existing debug_logger structure and MongoDB storage patterns.

stories.title: Append-Only Write Enforcement Logic
stories.description: Implement core audit logging pipeline enforcing append-only writes with no update/delete operations. Include hash chaining between records to support tamper detection.

stories.title: Audit Log Read API (Controlled Access)
stories.description: Expose read-only API for audit logs with filtering by event_type, time range, and actor. Ensure no mutation endpoints exist and access is restricted to authorized internal use.
stories.evidence: GAP: No existing audit read API; must be built on top of debug_logger persistence

stories.title: System-Wide Audit Logging Integration
stories.description: Integrate audit logging into tool_router, safety_service, and key domain services to capture all tool calls, safety events, and system actions using the append-only pipeline.

stories.title: Audit Logging Test Suite and Tamper Detection Validation
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating append-only behavior, hash chain integrity, and prevention of updates/deletes. Include tamper simulation scenarios.

per_feature.mitigation: Leverage existing debug_logger patterns and restrict scope to append-only enforcement without introducing new storage systems
